newsitem.title: USA: Key US senator to give stance on budget amendment.
newsitem.headline: Key US senator to give stance on budget amendment.

text.p: Sen. Mary Landrieu, one of two Democratic senators whose votes are critical to passage of the balanced budget constitutional amendment, will announce whether she will vote for the amendment at a 2 p.m. EST (1900 GMT) news conference, her office said Tuesday.

Landrieu told reporters Monday evening she had reservations about the amendment's impact on the Social Security retirement trust fund. She also was concerned that it could bar establishment of a federal capital budget.
However she pledged to vote for a constitutional balanced budget amendment during her campaign. "I committed to vote for an amendment, not for a particular version," she said.
